title: Providing and laying CC road from Lighthouse entrance gate to main road (Highway) at Chandrabhaga Lighthouse, Odisha.
summary: Offline notice inviting quotations (percentage rate) for building a cement concrete approach road from the lighthouse entrance gate to the main highway at Chandrabhaga Lighthouse, Puri district, Odisha, issued by the Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Kolkata.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Kolkata

sites.name: Chandrabhaga Lighthouse, Dist. Puri, Odisha 752111
sites.work: CC approach road from lighthouse entrance gate to main road (highway)

scope.item: Earth work excavation in trenches for foundation, lift up to 1.5 m, disposal within 1 km lead and back-filling (Rs 189.34 per cum, Rs 6,816.21)
Cement concrete 1:3:6 with 20 mm graded aggregate including mixing, placing, consolidation, curing (Rs 7,657.57 per cum, Rs 1,83,781.74)
Cement concrete 1:2:4 with 20 mm aggregate for CC road and pathway in panels, 150 mm thick, including form work, vibrating, curing (Rs 8,404.00 per cum, Rs 3,02,543.85)
Centering and shuttering including strutting, propping and removal of form (Rs 418.31 per sqm, Rs 12,549.19)

money.performance_security: 5% of contract value (FDR/BG) within 2 days of letter of intent, valid 6 months from completion (warranty period)
money.notes: Estimated cost inclusive of GST. EMD by DD/FDR of any nationalized/RBI approved bank in favour of Director of Lighthouses and Lightships, Kolkata; bids without EMD not considered. Percentage rate quotation; L1 on total basic amount. Penalty 0.5% per week, max 10%.

period.completion: 07 days from date of award of work
period.bid_validity: 180 days from date of opening of bid

eligibility: At least one similar work >= 80%, or two each >= 50%, or three each >= 40% of estimated value in last seven years
Similar work: experience in any civil works at Central Govt/State Govt/PSU/autonomous body
Tender acceptance letter (Annexure I) and undertaking on letterhead
specs: CC road in panels, 150 mm thick, M15-equivalent 1:2:4 mix over 1:3:6 base concrete

unreadable: Section 6 mentions a drawing but none is present in the text

notes: 15-page NIQ with percentage-rate price bid. Dates inconsistent: sealed quotations to reach by 06.10.2024 15:00 in the NIQ text, but table gives last date of submission 07.10.2024 15:00 and opening 07.10.2024 16:00 (table dates recorded).
